findings.evidence: New lemma, ProP/Basic.lean:183-185: `theorem isPGroup_range (hG : IsProP p G) (f : G →* H) (hf : IsOpen (f.ker : Set G)) : IsPGroup p f.range := (hG ⟨⟨f.ker, hf⟩, inferInstance⟩).of_equiv (QuotientGroup.quotientKerEquivRange f)`. Clone at FixedPoints.lean:74-78: `let K : OpenNormalSubgroup G := { toOpenSubgroup := { toSubgroup := (MulAction.toPermHom G M).ker, isOpen' := hK }, isNormal' := (MulAction.toPermHom G M).normal_ker }` / `(isProP_iff.mp hG K).of_equiv (QuotientGroup.quotientKerEquivRange _)`. It is the only such clone: grep for `quotientKerEquivRange` across TauCeti/ shows no other pro-p open-kernel site.
findings.fix: Delete the `let K := ...` block and lines 77-78 and use `have hQ : IsPGroup p (MulAction.toPermHom G M).range := hG.isPGroup_range (MulAction.toPermHom G M) hK`.
findings.issue: `exists_ne_zero_invariant_of_isProP_of_isOpen_ker` builds `K : OpenNormalSubgroup G` from `(MulAction.toPermHom G M).ker` plus `hK` and then proves `IsPGroup p (MulAction.toPermHom G M).range` by `(isProP_iff.mp hG K).of_equiv (QuotientGroup.quotientKerEquivRange _)` — character-for-character the body of the PR's generalized `IsProP.isPGroup_range`, which now applies here because the codomain no longer needs a topology.

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/OpenSubgroup.lean:304-306 `lemma subgroupOf_isOpen (U K : Subgroup G) (h : IsOpen (K : Set G)) : IsOpen (K.subgroupOf U : Set U) := Continuous.isOpen_preimage (continuous_iff_le_induced.mpr fun _ ↦ id) _ h` — same content, and it needs only `[Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]` (no `SeparatelyContinuousMul`), so it is compatible with the assumptions this PR removes. `MonoidHom.ker_domRestrict` (mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Subgroup/Ker.lean:291) already rewrites the kernel to `f.ker.subgroupOf K`. Already used elsewhere in the repo, e.g. TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/Homological/ContCohomology/Corestriction/Transitivity.lean:395.
findings.fix: Use the located lemma: `simpa [MonoidHom.ker_domRestrict] using Subgroup.subgroupOf_isOpen P U.toSubgroup U.isOpen`, dropping `Subgroup.coe_subgroupOf` and the hand-rolled preimage argument.
findings.issue: The openness side goal in `isPGroup_map_mk'` is discharged by re-deriving the preimage fact (`U.isOpen.preimage continuous_subtype_val` plus `Subgroup.coe_subgroupOf` in the simp set); Mathlib already names exactly this statement.

summary: The generalizations reuse Mathlib correctly (ZModModule.isPGroup_multiplicative, IsPGroup.of_pow, isPGroup_iff_exists_pow_pow_eq_one), but the newly generalized isPGroup_range leaves a verbatim clone of its own proof in ProP/FixedPoints.lean, and the new isPGroup_map_mk' proof re-derives Mathlib's Subgroup.subgroupOf_isOpen.
